title: Do spiders dream? Scientists just found a surprising clue
caption:
Researchers filmed the tiny jumping spider Portia fimbriata and discovered it naps in two stages, one with eye flicks just like human REM. While this doesn’t prove dreaming, it shows spiders have complex sleep. Could the next dream be a spider’s?

Source: Sciencedaily - Do spiders dream? Scientists just found a surprising clue

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261026225555.htm
